name: Ex
source:
A boy from Cinderella Story Zone. Both him and Cinderella lost their parents at an early age, so they became childhood friends.
When Ex joined Reina's group, he manifested a rare Wild Crest, which let him connect with all sort of Heroes without limits.
Despite his calm demeanor, he has a strong will that never gets shaken by any kind of adversity.
